overview_description.description: Malama Health offers holistic support through community-based doulas, covering various services like pregnancy care and postpartum recovery. The company connects community-based doulas, health plans, and clinical systems across Medicaid markets through a unified operating model that standardizes referral processes, data tracking, risk management, and quality assessment. By incorporating remote patient monitoring, chronic disease management, and Doula-Care Navigators, Malama Health assists women from pregnancy through the postpartum period, addressing clinical requirements, social health factors, and long-term disease prevention all in one location.

about_short_description.short_description: Malama offers holistic support through community-based doulas, covering various services like pregnancy care and postpartum recovery.

product.name: Malama App
product.description: A mobile application designed to help track pregnancy, receive personalized insights, connect with healthcare providers, and discover in-network benefits.

product.name: Medically Tailored Meals
product.description: Curated meal plans by prenatal nutritionists, catering to various cuisines and dietary needs, aimed at supporting healthier pregnancies.

product.name: Device Syncing
product.description: The app syncs with various health monitoring devices such as CGMs, blood glucometers, BP cuffs, activity trackers, and weight scales to log and share health data.

product.name: Real-time Data Sharing
product.description: Allows users to share health data with their care team either as a report or in real-time, facilitating better healthcare support.

product.name: In-network Support
product.description: Access to OB/GYNs, dietitians, doulas for in-network support, enhancing the care and guidance available to users.

product.name: Gestational Diabetes Management
product.description: Features and resources specifically designed to support the management of gestational diabetes, including tracking, insights, and meal planning.
